{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted wool-blend blazer, structured lapel, knee-length hem, charcoal grey (#36454F), virgin wool.
Rib-knit silk-cotton turtleneck, close neck, hip-length cut, cream white (#F5F5DC), lightweight cotton-silk blend.
High-waisted pleated trousers, tapered leg, ankle length, navy blue (#000080), heavy stretch twill.
Ankle boots with a low block heel, rounded toe, mid-calf shaft, chocolate brown (#3B241D), smooth leather sole for traction on salted roads.

This ensemble adheres to the requested "neat" work dress code while providing essential warmth against -10°C and snow through heavy wool and insulated layers. The dark charcoal and navy palette ensures a polished professional appearance that blends seamlessly with wintry surroundings, avoiding any distracting light colors. Practical details like the structured blazer prevent wind chill during your twenty-minute walk, and the rubberized leather soles offer necessary grip on slippery, salted sidewalks without sacrificing style."}
